explicit_pivot: The biological inferential target is NOT which astronomical time transform has the best logscore. It is whether detected time-use niches shift between early and late growing season at matched DAYLENGTH, and whether species redistribute toward daylight edges or into nighttime with shared or divergent directions.

correct_calendar.forbidden_mislabel: DO NOT call these pairs spring versus autumn. They are rising daylength in late spring/early summer versus falling daylength in midsummer.

ecological_question: Given nearly equal daylight length at a physically fixed camera station, do the four sympatric ungulates allocate their detectable daily activity differently between the cooler early growing-season and the later summer period? Is the change common among species or ecologically divergent?

biological_mechanism_contrasts.prediction: After matching daylength and accounting for station and hourly camera exposure, relative core-daylight, daylight-edge, and night detection intensities remain unchanged by rising/falling daylength branch within each taxon.
biological_mechanism_contrasts.falsifier: Supported branch×time-zone rate differences in heldout site replication.

biological_mechanism_contrasts.prediction: Later summer redistributes detected daytime encounters from central daylight toward dawn/dusk-adjacent daylight, without necessarily increasing night; core-vs-edge log-rate ratio decreases.
biological_mechanism_contrasts.corollary: If measured daily heat is a plausible proximate driver, predicted change is stronger on hotter date pairs AFTER matched daylength. This is an association, NOT evidence of thermoregulatory cause.
biological_mechanism_contrasts.falsifier: Core-to-edge odds are stable or increase, with enough independent source-qualified opportunity support.

biological_mechanism_contrasts.prediction: Later summer redistributes detected encounters from daylight to night; night-to-all-daylight rate ratio increases, not merely core-to-edge redistribution.
biological_mechanism_contrasts.falsifier: Night-to-daylight rate stays stable while core-to-edge changes, with source-qualified effort.

biological_mechanism_contrasts.prediction: Species show heterogeneous sign and/or magnitude of changes in the above two orthogonal ecological responses even when compared at the same camera station/date pairs; an overall pooled ungulate rhythm is inadequate.
biological_mechanism_contrasts.falsifier: Species×branch×temporal-zone interaction near zero with sufficiently precise independent-site validation.
biological_mechanism_contrasts.limit: Heterogeneous species responses are not proof of interspecific competition, because detection alone cannot identify interaction or individual resource payoff.

zone_definitions.solar_daylight_core: Central HALF of sunrise-to-sunset daylight, [sunrise+0.25*daylength,sunrise+0.75*daylength), i.e. solar-phase 09:00–15:00.
zone_definitions.solar_night: Outside sunrise-to-sunset, excludes nothing else; solar noon computed from publicly reported generalized site coordinates and SOURCE date only.
zone_definitions.equal_daytime_zone_duration: When a camera operates throughout all daylight, daylight core and combined daylight edges have equal hours for each DATE, avoiding a trivial difference from category duration.
zone_definitions.time_basis: All animal events retain original local Asia/Seoul civil timestamps. Solar boundaries are only externally computed labels, not separate fitted response spaces.

primary_ecological_estimands.definition: Within physical site and matched daylength-date pairs, the early-vs-late change in log(EFFORT-adjusted daylight-core detections / daylight-edge detections) for each species, with site fixed effects and all eligible zero-event operation cells retained.
primary_ecological_estimands.interpretation: Conditional detected temporal refuge allocation, not true latent activity without independent detector q calibration.

primary_ecological_estimands.definition: The early-vs-late change in log(EFFORT-adjusted night detections / total daylight detections) for each species.
primary_ecological_estimands.interpretation: Distinguish partial daytime-edge retreat from whole-night allocation.

primary_ecological_estimands.definition: Differential branch effect of four declared taxa across core/edge/night categories under the same original station/time effort frame.
primary_ecological_estimands.interpretation: Evidence of differential temporal niche reassembly; no mechanistic proof of competition or endogenous circadian change.

ecological_controls.site_composition: Use identical physically deployed camera station roster for both branches; do not compare species-specific site subsets selected on having positive event detections.
ecological_controls.human_context: Public annual station frequency_of_people can be used ONLY as exploratory between-site context, not as hour-of-day human activity or causal human avoidance.
ecological_controls.thermal_context: Use a single externally defined hourly/daily temperature dataset and unaltered extraction rule if supplied; absent independent temperature data, call the result matched-daylength seasonal history, not thermal causation.
ecological_controls.solar_context: Allow small actual sunrise/sunset and equation-of-time differences; classify zones by actual date and the PUBLIC site-level representative astronomical geometry, not invented station GPS.
ecological_controls.two_regions: UJ1 and UJ2 are only 2 landscapes. Never generalize an estimated random landscape variance or independent 82-region inference.
ecological_controls.temporal_overlap: Species-pair kernel overlap is a SECONDARY descriptive consequence of marginal densities, not independent proof of competition or causal interaction.
ecological_controls.source_q: All detector-q and independent operation-log issues found in prior ODSP methods remain HOLD for latent biological activity; detected-event zone patterns can only be source-admitted after verifying actual operating HOURS.

real_data_admission.first_data_gate: Compute species×branch×clock-zone detectable events and source-audited operational HOURS for all 41 calendar pairs, WITHOUT altering pairs after looking at events.
real_data_admission.if_only_functional_nights_or_station_sea: HOLD_NO_HOURLY_OPERATION_DURATION; can report timestamp-only exploratory distributions but NO effort-adjusted ecological intensity result.
real_data_admission.source_only_site_geometry: Use generalized representative site coordinates, not protected camera location; flag geographic uncertainty in solar bounds.
real_data_admission.minimum_descriptive_support: Report original 4 species regardless of n. Mark each species as LOW_SUPPORT if fewer than 30 independent events in EITHER branch or fewer than 8 physical stations with independently logged positive operation hours in BOTH branches. Threshold is an exploration/display guard, NOT proof of power.

novelty_guard.ecologically_distinct_test: Matched DAYLENGTH paired dates plus response-mechanism partition (core-to-edge vs daylight-to-night) and four species interactions at unchanged physical camera locations.

never_change: Frozen 41 date pairs and sunrise calculation, all prior 5 model families and qualified ODSP source inference remain untouched.
Do not report real ecological observations until original EcoBank v1.1 event/operation source file provenance and exact deployment-time support established.
Do not present prior artificial 96-bin detector-calibration positive outcomes as a biological activity discovery.
Do not use source calendar 'spring-autumn' terminology for May/June versus July/August.
Do not change hypothesis sign or split category definitions after inspecting real event results.
